subject: Air-gapped update certification and swap ceremony coordination
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta@acme-corp.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: edgeops@acme-corp.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Air-gapped delivery: chain of custody + operator requirements

Hi Priyom and Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team wants a concise, auditable flow for receiving signed images into our sealed site. Two quick asks: 1) what artifacts do you expect us to accept (manifest, checksums, certs), and 2) what does the operator swap ceremony look like from Redwood's side?

We need this documented before our procurement team will sign the SOW. Can you send a short checklist and proposed dates for the ceremony?

If helpful, our on-site point is Edge Ops (edgeops@acme-corp.com) — they will handle physical receipts.

— Marta
Marta Lopez
Head of Cloud Ops, Acme Robotics

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta@acme-corp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Air-gapped delivery: chain of custody + operator requirements

Marta — thanks for the clear ask. High-level response below and attached a one-page checklist (acoc-checklist-v1.xlsx) plus our artifact manifest template (artifact-manifest-v1.json).

Short answers: 1) Required artifacts: signed image bundle (tar.gz), artifact-manifest.json with SHA256 checksums, operator certificate (PEM), notarization signature (our HSM sig), and a courier transfer receipt. 2) Swap ceremony: a two-person operator ceremony with live hash verification and mutual attestation. We call this the "Swap & Sign" ceremony. Steps:

- Pre-provision: Redwood produces signed bundle, manifest, and a short signing statement signed by our KMS. We publish an ACOS (AirGap Chain of Custody) document to the shared Drive link and send courier ETA.
- On arrival: Acme Edge Ops personnel verify courier seal and serial; operator A and B perform offline checksum verification against manifest using our provided verification utility on an isolated laptop.
- Attestation: Operator A signs the acceptance token with their operator certificate; Operator B countersigns. Both operator certificates must be in the accepted roster (we'll exchange cert fingerprints ahead of time).
- Activation window: After receipt and countersignatures, Redwood issues an activation key (time-bound) which Acme uses to unlock the package. A final verification report is uploaded to the shared Drive.

I suggest a ceremony window the week of May 3rd — please confirm on-site availability.

Attachments: acoc-checklist-v1.xlsx (procedural checklist), artifact-manifest-v1.json (manifest template).

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Senior Product Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta@acme-corp.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Air-gapped delivery: chain of custody + operator requirements

Adding a few security items we should include in the checklist:

- Require physical seal serial to be recorded in the manifest (photo + handwritten receipt).
- Include an HSM sig verification step and the exact OpenSSL command we expect for PEM validation (so auditors can reproduce).
- Add an emergency rollback token process in case a bundle fails post-activation (time-limited revocation cert).
- Operator roster: request operator cert fingerprints from Acme in advance (we'll share ours).

Also: recommend the activation key be delivered via an out-of-band channel (DocuSign or signed USB with one-time passphrase) — avoids embedding it in courier metadata.

I'll draft the extra rows into acoc-checklist-v1 and circulate.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>

We can support the week of May 3rd. Proposed timeline for the Swap & Sign ceremony (local times):

- May 4, 11:00 — On-site courier arrival window; operator A/B handshake + live verification (target 45m).
- May 4, 13:00 — Activation window (we issue activation token after countersignature).

Operational notes:
- We'll bring two USB verification toolkits: one air-gapped verification laptop (preloaded, hash tool, instructions) and one for operator attestations.
- We'll request a photograph of the manifest with courier seal serialized and upload to Drive during the ceremony.

Marta — if that date works, can Edge Ops confirm contact name(s) and operator certificate fingerprints by Apr 29? We'll also need the courier company name and expected tracking number once booked.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Delivery Lead, Redwood Inference
